function: Surveys adversarial attacks and defenses against AI models in 6G IoT systems.
note: The abstract presents the work as a survey of adversarial attacks and defenses in 6G IoT, with simulations only illustrating attacks.

function: Proposes a sensing capability metric and evaluation methodology for 6G ISAC.
note: The work defines a sensing performance metric evaluated by system simulation and has no learned component.

function: Federated multi-agent DRL manages network slices and resources for satellite direct-to-device links.
note: Network slicing is above the physical layer, but the learned resource allocation for direct satellite links may be bandwidth or power control covered by the NTN exception, so the full text should decide.

function: LSTM predicts content popularity; BCD optimizes UAV caching, trajectory, power, and bandwidth.
note: The only learned component predicts content popularity for caching, while the power and bandwidth of the aerial links are optimized by block coordinate descent without learning.

function: Model-based meta reinforcement learning decides task offloading for train control edge computing.
note: Learning is applied to computation offloading and train control, which are above the physical layer.

function: Diffusion-model policy within MAPPO makes vertical handover decisions in SAGIN.
note: The learned method decides vertical handovers, a function above the physical layer, and does not learn any ISAC beam, waveform, or resource.

function: Multi-objective RL with MPC and PSO optimizes UAV trajectories and edge computing.
note: Learning targets UAV trajectories, task completion, load balancing, and computational resource deployment for edge computing, with no learned radio power, bandwidth, or beam control stated.

function: TD3 controls UAV flight for user tracking with ISAC-aided collision avoidance.
note: The learned agent decides UAV flying actions, that is the trajectory, while the OFDM ISAC system only supplies obstacle distances and is not learned.

function: Multi-agent TD3 optimizes UAV trajectories, user association, and task offloading.
note: The learned decisions are trajectory planning, user association, and task offloading, all above the physical layer.

function: YOLO and Mask R-CNN segment rip currents in UAV imagery for surveillance.
note: Learning is only the image-segmentation application carried by the UAV and IoT network, and no physical-layer function is learned.

function: Graph-based self-supervised learning localizes smartphones from WiFi CSI at scale.
note: The learned task is CSI-based indoor localization of devices, an excluded function despite the ISAC framing.

function: Applies Hamming and convolutional codes to hierarchical beam training in XL-MIMO.
note: Beam training is improved with channel coding theory, which is not a learned method.

function: Proposes stochastic quantum spiking neurons trained with a local learning rule.
note: The learned model is a generic quantum spiking neural network evaluated on benchmark datasets, with neuromorphic ISAC mentioned only as a potential application.

function: Sparse Bayesian learning recovers the downlink mmWave channel from padded uplink training.
note: Sparse Bayesian learning here is an iterative compressive-sensing estimator run on each observation, not a model trained on data or by interaction.

function: Surveys AI-based jamming and interference detection and mitigation in 5G/6G.
note: The article is explicitly a survey of AI-based interference management.

function: Surveys machine learning and deep learning techniques for visible light communication.
note: The article is explicitly a comprehensive survey of ML and DL in VLC systems.

function: Pilot-aware transformer predicts uplink spectral efficiency from noisy partial massive MIMO CSI.
note: The learned model predicts achievable spectral efficiency for link adaptation rather than estimating, compressing, or predicting the channel itself.

function: RAG-enhanced LLM answers RF sensing questions and analyzes radar spectrograms.
note: The learned system performs technical question answering, code retrieval, and radar spectrogram recognition, none of which is one of the seven functions.

function: Spatio-temporal liquid network identifies electromagnetic signals in RIS-aided UAV links.
note: Electromagnetic signal identification is an excluded function even in an RIS-aided UAV setting.

function: ROMP-assisted multi-sector subspace sensing for near-field localization with holographic surfaces.
note: The estimators are subspace and sparse-recovery algorithms that explicitly avoid data-driven learning.

function: Elman neural network tracks ocean targets for UAV; Lyapunov optimization handles offloading.
note: The learned part is UAV target tracking, a flight decision, while offloading and resource allocation use Lyapunov optimization without learning.

function: CNN measures thoracoabdominal asynchrony from multi-antenna mmWave radar signals.
note: This is radar-only vital-sign sensing in a system that does not communicate.

function: Federated, multithreaded SAC and PPO plan UAV trajectories in RIS-assisted links.
note: The learned decision is UAV trajectory planning, and the abstract does not state that RIS phases, power, or other physical-layer variables are learned.

function: Safe hierarchical RL decides UAV access control, computing resources, and block size.
note: The learned decisions are access control, computational resource allocation, and blockchain block size, all above the physical layer.

function: Hierarchical federated multi-agent DRL solves auction-based resource trading and task offloading.
note: The learned method handles task offloading and auction-based trading of UAV and HAP resources to minimize computation costs, which are above the physical layer.

function: Decentralized FL via UAV model dissemination with graph-theoretic mmWave resource scheduling.
note: Federated learning is only the application, its aggregation is digital through UAV model dissemination rather than over-the-air computation, and the resource scheduling uses graph theory without learning.

function: Convolutional beamspace with ESPRIT estimates hybrid mmWave MIMO channels.
note: Channel estimation uses spatial filtering, downsampling, and subspace methods with no learned component.

function: Swin Transformer localizes users indoors from MIMO CSI fingerprints.
note: The learned task is CSI fingerprint localization, an excluded function even within a MIMO ISAC setting.

function: COMA-based multi-agent DRL decides task offloading and resource allocation in satellite MEC.
note: The learned decisions are collaborative task offloading and the allocation of satellite edge computing resources, with no transmit power, bandwidth, or beam control of the satellite links stated.

function: Direction-adaptive neural networks perform digital predistortion for hybrid beamforming transmitters.
note: Digital predistortion is power amplifier linearization, an excluded function.

function: DRL with Lagrangian iteration optimizes AR rendering, resource allocation, and UAV placement.
note: Rendering offloading and UAV placement are above the physical layer, but the abstract does not say whether the hybrid DRL method also learns radio resources of the UAV link, which the aerial exception would cover.

function: Distributed decision-transformer actor-critic orchestrates service function chains in UAV swarms.
note: Service function chain orchestration, that is VNF embedding, is network management above the physical layer.

function: Interleaved beam/antenna-domain training for massive MIMO; DNN only approximates training length.
note: The training schemes are analytical designs, and the DNN serves only as a surrogate for performance evaluation, not as the method performing the physical-layer function.

function: BCD/SCA optimizes RIS phases, power, bandwidth, and CPU frequency for FL.
note: The RIS and resource design uses BCD, SCA, and closed-form solutions without learning, and the per-user bandwidth allocation indicates digital rather than over-the-air aggregation.

function: Multi-agent learning trains offloading, UAV trajectory, and caching; optimization handles subchannels/power.
note: The learned decisions are task offloading, flight trajectory, and program caching, while subchannel allocation and power control are solved by optimization without learning.

function: PPO-based MADRL with embedded optimization jointly sets UAV trajectories, power, and resources.
note: Transmit power control and communication resource allocation of the aerial links are optimized within a MADRL framework, but the abstract does not say whether they are learned or solved by the embedded SCA and Dinkelbach steps.

function: Optimizes MIMO AirComp precoding and equalization for over-the-air DNN inference.
note: The precoder and Wiener-type equalizer are derived by optimization without learning, and the DNN is only the split-inference application rather than federated model aggregation.

function: LLM-based critic-regularized decision transformer learns UAV trajectory control for data collection.
note: The learned policy controls the UAV trajectory, while resource allocation is solved optimally by linear programming without learning.
